HOMEPAGE.PART1TITLE: Enjoy the best beauty services at home
HOMEPAGE.PART1TEXT: Our qualified professionals come to your place to offer you high-quality beauty treatments tailored to your needs and desires. Experience unique well-being, whether it's during your lunch break, after work in the evening, or for an afternoon with friends.
HOMEPAGE.PART2TITLE: Work when you want, generate custom income
HOMEPAGE.PART2TEXT: Generate income on your own schedule by accepting requests on the platform at your own pace. You can use your own equipment or choose to rent professional equipment via izyGlam.
HOMEPAGE.PART3TITLE: A reimagined beauty service for businesses
HOMEPAGE.PART3TEXT: Glam for Business is a platform designed for businesses of all sizes, built to meet the beauty needs of your customers and employees. Offer personalized beauty treatments directly in the workplace, during corporate events, or for special occasions. Our qualified professionals come to provide services tailored to your needs.

CONFIDENTIAL.INTRO_BIS: When you use izyGlam, you entrust us with your personal data. We are committed to honoring that trust by protecting your information. This privacy statement describes the personal data ('data') we collect, how we use and share it, and your choices regarding it. We recommend reading this document carefully.
CONFIDENTIAL.DECLARATION: This statement applies to users of the izyGlam platform, which connects individuals and businesses with independent beauty professionals such as manicurists, pedicurists, makeup artists, and hairdressers. It covers all services offered by izyGlam worldwide.
CONFIDENTIAL.PERSONNAL: Personal information (name, email address, phone number), account information (login credentials, passwords, beauty service preferences), payment information (credit card details, bank information, transaction history)
CONFIDENTIAL.CREATE_DATA: Data created during the use of our services
CONFIDENTIAL.HISTORY: Browsing history, cookies, IP address, browser type, operating system, time spent on the platform
CONFIDENTIAL.DETAILS: Details about contacted beauty professionals, requested services, appointment schedules, exchanged communications
CONFIDENTIAL.BEST_SERVICES: Provide and improve our services, personalize your experience, and process your orders.
CONFIDENTIAL.PARTICULIER: Facilitate the connection between individuals/businesses and independent beauty professionals.
CONFIDENTIAL.SEND: Send you information about our products, services, special offers, and new features.
CONFIDENTIAL.ASSURER: Ensure the security of our systems and prevent fraud.
CONFIDENTIAL.EFFECTUER: Perform analyses to understand usage trends on the platform.
CONFIDENTIAL.PERSONNALISER: Personalize your experience based on your preferences and usage history.
CONFIDENTIAL.RGPD: Under GDPR, you have the right to
CONFIDENTIAL.PERSONNAL_DATA_ACCESS: Access your personal data and request a copy of it.
CONFIDENTIAL.ASK_CORRECTION: Request the correction of incorrect or incomplete data.
CONFIDENTIAL.ASK_DELETE: Request the deletion of your data ('right to be forgotten').
CONFIDENTIAL.RESTREINDRE: Restrict or object to the processing of your data.
CONFIDENTIAL.ASK_PORTA: Request the portability of your data to another service.
CONFIDENTIAL.CONSENT: Withdraw your consent at any time when the processing is based on consent.
CONFIDENTIAL.RECLAMATION: File a complaint with a competent supervisory authority if you believe your rights are not being respected.
CONFIDENTIAL.MANAGE_COOKIES_PREF: You can manage your cookie preferences through your browser settings or a cookie management tool available on our website. In the future, izyGlam may use other technologies for user tracking.
CONFIDENTIAL.WE_SHARE: We only share your personal data with trusted third parties necessary for processing your orders and providing services such as
CONFIDENTIAL.FOURNISSEUR_SERV: Payment service providers for secure transaction processing.
CONFIDENTIAL.TRANSPORT: Carriers or couriers for product delivery, if applicable.
CONFIDENTIAL.MARKETING: Marketing and advertising service providers, only with your consent.
CONFIDENTIAL.HEALTHCARE: Independent beauty professionals with whom you have booked an appointment through the platform.
CONFIDENTIAL.CLOUD: Cloud and hosting service providers to ensure the availability and security of our platform.
CONFIDENTIAL.WE_SAVE: We retain your personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected, including to comply with any legal, accounting, or reporting obligations. Data is generally kept between 3 and 6 months.
CONFIDENTIAL.TECHNICAL: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data from loss, misuse, unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, or destruction. These measures include data encryption in transit and at rest, strong authentication for access to internal systems, as well as continuous monitoring of threats and potential security breaches. We have not yet implemented protocols for data breach responses, but it is something we are considering for the future.
CONFIDENTIAL.PERSONNAL_DATA: The personal data we collect may be transferred to and stored in countries outside the European Economic Area (EEA). When these transfers occur, we ensure they are carried out in accordance with applicable regulations by using mechanisms such as the European Commission's approved standard contractual clauses.
CONFIDENTIAL.QUESTION: For any questions regarding our privacy policy or to exercise your rights, please contact us at: userprotection@izyglam.com.
CONFIDENTIAL.RESERVES: We reserve the right to modify this privacy policy at any time. In the event of significant changes, we will notify you via email. We encourage you to regularly review this page to stay informed of updates.

CREATE_SHOP_INFO.TITLE: Grow your business
CREATE_SHOP_INFO.TEXT: Thousands of izyGlam app users may be searching for a restaurant in your area...

STEP1.TITLE: Work on your own terms
STEP1.TEXT: Manage your schedule and handle your services with complete freedom. Enjoy a flexible platform that adapts to your needs to maximize your activity.

STEP2.TITLE: Strengthen your online presence
STEP2.TEXT: Attract more customers with the marketing tools included in the app and boost your results with increased visibility.

STEP3.TITLE: Build customer loyalty
STEP3.TEXT: Develop long-term relationships by analyzing your customers' preferences, responding to their reviews, and offering them loyalty benefits.

STEP1.TITLE: Simplify the management of your business
STEP1.TEXT: Manage your business with ease thanks to izyGlam, the complete solution for wellness professionals. Take advantage of flexible tools and personalized support to meet all your needs.

STEP2.TITLE: Boost your sales
STEP2.TEXT: Every day, thousands of people use izyGlam to find beauty experts near them. Take advantage of this opportunity to reach new customers in your field.

STEP3.TITLE: Guaranteed customer satisfaction
STEP3.TEXT: With izyGlam, offer your customers a personalized experience. Easily manage your appointments, communicate quickly, and offer tailored services. Your clients receive treatments where and when they want, ensuring their satisfaction and loyalty.

CREATION_COMPANY_STEPS.TITLE: How izyGlam works for your company

STEP1.TITLE: Your employees and customers book services
STEP1.TEXT: Your employees or customers select the wellness services that suit them directly through the izyGlam app.

STEP2.TITLE: You decide on an allocation amount
STEP2.TEXT: You have control over crediting your employees' and customers' accounts. You can choose to credit these accounts periodically or as a one-time event.

STEP3.TITLE: Services are performed
STEP3.TEXT: Our beauty experts visit your employees or come to your premises to provide the reserved services, guaranteeing an optimal wellness experience.

CREATE_COMPANY_INFO.TITLE: Enhance your company
CREATE_COMPANY_INFO.TEXT: Thousands of izyGlam app users are looking for wellness services. Offer your employees and customers privileged access to the best beauty experts near them.

STEP1.TITLE: Retain and reward your employees
STEP1.TEXT: Offer your teams a unique benefit by providing them with a monthly beauty budget. Hairdressers, beauticians, and many other wellness experts are at their disposal to enhance their satisfaction and strengthen their sense of belonging to your company.

STEP2.TITLE: Improve your brand image
STEP2.TEXT: Organize beauty events for your customers or partners, or integrate izyGlam services into your loyalty programs. Make a lasting impression with premium treatments tailored to any occasion.

STEP3.TITLE: Optimize workplace wellness
STEP3.TEXT: Make it easy for your employees to access wellness services directly at their workplace or nearby. By taking care of their well-being, you boost their motivation and strengthen team cohesion.

STEP1.TITLE: Simplify access to wellness for your teams
STEP1.TEXT: With izyGlam, offer your employees a simple and flexible solution to take care of themselves. Whether for beauty treatments or fitness sessions, everything is within reach.

STEP2.TITLE: Offer innovative benefits to your clients
STEP2.TEXT: Strengthen your relationships with your clients by offering wellness services at events or as part of your loyalty programs. Show them you care about their experience with unique services.

STEP3.TITLE: Tailored wellness, where and when you want it
STEP3.TEXT: With izyGlam, your employees and clients can enjoy quality services wherever they are. Selected experts will meet their specific needs, with personalized service to ensure their satisfaction.
